policy.method: one attenuation-only cascade multiplier per body, solved iteratively at the hottest sampled PRODUCT Morph/Q row
policy.mutationScope: SCALE packed word 4 only; pole words 2/3 and zero words 0/1 are byte-identical
policy.relationshipPolicy: the same total cascade multiplier is applied to every authored corner; corner and morph gain relationships are preserved
policy.levelGate: fixed 5x5 Morph x Q audio sample grid must contain zero rows above +0.10 dB; sampled certification, not continuum proof
